desc: Partially open-air cafe with vegetarian food, including millet pizza & pumpkin soup.
addr: #64, 10th Main Rd, 4th Block, 5th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560041, India

rev.t: Go Native, Jayanagar is one of our go-to places whenever we want a relaxed meal in a cozy outdoor setting. The ambience is peaceful, the staff are genuinely friendly, and the service is always warm and attentive. …

Food is great.
Buratte pizza was delicious. Its buzzed with flames on the tables which makes the experience better. …

Had a good dining experience here. The food was good and modern with Indian flavours. The service was good and they were friendly. The atmosphere inside was good and there are some cloths and accessories that you can buy inside. …
